prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect
Company: Kobie

<job_posting>
Join a National Top Workplace 
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where

requirements.text: 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements analysis, or technical pre‑sales within a technology environment.
Document business requirements into BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs that keep solutions traceable from discovery through delivery.
Validate delivery cost estimates (COGS) across data/analytics, software, CS, and strategy workstreams to confirm feasibility.
Apply Agile/Scrum, waterfall, and iterative delivery methodologies to structure solution plans that fit each client’s approach.
Build solution demos, proposals, and pitch materials that establish technical credibility in RFP, RFI, and upsell settings.
Coordinate dependencies across marketing, data/analytics, and partner integration workstreams to keep multi‑team solutions aligned.
Identify scope drift and delivery risk, translating findings into corrective action plans for delivery and client teams.
Working knowledge of loyalty marketing programs and mechanics.
Delivery experience in retail, financial services, or travel & hospitality.
Familiarity with MarTech platforms (e.g., campaign management, CDP, personalization tools) to align solutions with a client’s tech stack.
Willingness and ability to travel as needed, up to once per quarter.
